title: AS/NZS 3000 Wiring Rules — Structure & Application
objective: Build a practical method for locating, interpreting and documenting relevant AS/NZS 3000 requirements without treating standards as a collection of isolated clauses.

learn.heading: What senior designers should understand
bullets: Start with the design question and installation context before searching the standard.
Distinguish mandatory requirements, project specifications, engineering judgement and items requiring verification.
Use clause references as traceable design evidence rather than copying requirements without context.
Record the edition and source used so a reviewer can reproduce the design decision.
Escalate interpretation questions when the requirement affects safety, compliance or an approval boundary.
learn.takeaway: Senior standards use is traceable: the designer can explain what requirement applies, why it applies and where the decision is recorded.

apply.scenario: A fictional LV pump-station package requires equipment connections, isolation, cable routes and a small distribution board. Several design notes have been written without clause references.
tasks: Create a standards compliance matrix with at least eight design topics relevant to the package.
For each topic, record the requirement/question, source reference, design response and verification status.
Identify two items where the project specification may add requirements beyond the base standard.
Flag one interpretation that should be reviewed by the responsible electrical engineer before issue.
Write a short rule for how standards references will be maintained through revisions.
apply.deliverable: A sanitized standards compliance matrix with traceable references, design responses and open questions.

questions.q: What is the strongest way to use a standards clause in a design record?
a: Copy the clause into every drawing note.
Reference the applicable requirement, explain the design response and retain enough context for review.
Mention the standard name without a reference.
questions.why: Traceability connects the requirement to the actual engineering decision.

questions.q: A clause appears relevant but the installation context is uncertain. What should happen first?
a: Clarify the installation context and verify the applicable requirement before relying on it.
questions.why: Standards application depends on scope and installation conditions.

questions.q: A project specification conflicts with a generic drafting convention. What is the safest approach?
a: Record the conflict, determine the governing requirement and obtain clarification where necessary.
questions.why: Conflicts must be resolved against controlled project requirements.

check.passRule: Explain why the selected answer is appropriate and identify what evidence would support the decision.

evidence.prompt: Capture a sanitized standards compliance matrix or design note showing how you traced requirements into design decisions.
criteria: Open questions and assumptions are visible.

integration.home: Recommend Week 7 after completion and show standards application as a learning milestone.
integration.journal: Reflect on how you distinguish a standard requirement from a project-specific requirement and when you escalate interpretation.
integration.portfolio: Add the standards compliance matrix as evidence of controlled standards application.
